## ShuYi-Agent v0.5.4

### Highlights

- Serializes local TTS generation so rapid manual clicks enter a first-in-first-out queue instead of competing for GPU memory.
- Changes chapter batch dubbing to generate each utterance independently; one long or failing line is marked failed with a split-line hint while other lines continue.
- Keeps frontend utterance/audio mapping stable by merging batch audio results by `utterance_id` instead of replacing the visible list by response order.
- Filters decorative separator lines such as `————` and `……` out of generated dubbing utterances.
- Adds “跳转到未确认” and “确认已选台词与角色” controls for faster manual review before automatic dubbing continues.
- Adds “导出音色库” to package all voice resources and a manifest into a downloadable archive.

### Deployment Notes

- GitHub Pages remains a static frontend; push to `main` publishes the updated frontend via the existing `gh-pages` workflow.
- CNB image tags are now `v0.5.4-cpu` and `v0.5.4-cuda` when the CNB tag pipeline runs with `CNB_TAG=v0.5.4`.
